notes.title: Demo Update 1.01
notes.content:
Demo Patch 1.01 Update

- Fixed a bug where the relics "Squire's Shield" and "Beginner's Belt" would not grant a stat boost to the battle right after they are equipped.
- Rebalanced booster pack item rates
- Fixed a bug where controller keycaps were shown while using keyboard controls.
- Increased the appearance rate of a rare achievement event when you have cleared both demo paths.

notes.title: Fudgy Dice New Demo and Store page Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a year since the original announcement of Fudgy Dice! Ever since then, over 500 of you have wishlisted the game as a sign of interest. I'm truly grateful for that!

A lot has happened in the past year, but I'm proud to announce the brand new demo for Fudgy Dice is live, this demo features a bunch of the roguelike singleplayer features missing from the prior demo, as well as a much more refined gameplay system. 

The new gameplay system took a lot of trial and error, but I'm confident you will all greatly enjoy it! However, with it comes less of a focus on multiplayer gameplay, as I wish to pursue this game fully as a single-player release! Though multiplayer isn't a closed door, for now, we're moving forward with developing Fudgy Dice as a single-player title!

The new demo features the first 20 minutes of gameplay, 2 different paths, and a bunch of secrets and achievements to discover! I hope you'll enjoy what we're able to share with you today!

If you're interested in following future updates for the game, we've created a discord server where you can follow the game, the link to it is on the Steam page!

Thank you so much for your support so far with Fudgy Dice, and enjoy the demo!

~Ami

notes.title: Fudgy Dice First Demo Release
notes.content:
Fudgy Dice goes live with its first demo!

This demo features a small teaser of the full game, it includes 2 of the game's playable characters. Daisy and fudgy, with a small number of dice available in the full game. This gives you a chance to try the game before the full release. 

Multiplayer is included in this demo, so feel free to join a friend locally or through steam remote play together to experience fun for two!

I hope you all have fun with Fudgy Dice's first demo, future demos will include more of the game's features, but for now, I hope you all enjoy what I've got to share.

Any feedback on the game can be sent to contact.studio.ami@gmail.com

Have a great day everyone,

Ami
